groups.title: Europe — job boards and institutes
groups.note: Many European professorships are advertised only on the university's own career page, so also check the departments you're interested in directly.

items.name: Nature Careers
items.note: Worldwide. Its rules don't allow automated reading of the job feeds.

items.name: Academics.com
items.note: Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Its terms don't allow automated reading.

items.name: CNRS researcher competitions
items.note: France. Permanent research posts (CRCN, DR) are filled through a yearly national competition, usually opening in December.

items.name: EMBL careers
items.note: Group leader posts at EMBL sites across Europe.

items.name: Institut Pasteur
items.note: Paris; group leader calls are announced here.

items.name: Helmholtz Association
items.note: German national research centres, including infection and environmental research.

items.name: Wellcome Sanger Institute
items.note: UK; faculty and group leader posts in genomics.

groups.title: Europe — independent group and fellowship programmes

items.name: DFG Emmy Noether Programme
items.note: Germany. Funding to lead an independent junior research group, often a route to a professorship.

groups.title: Asia — Hong Kong
groups.note: Hong Kong's universities hire mainly through their own career pages. The government's Global STEM Professorship Scheme is offered through the universities rather than as a separate application.

items.name: AcademicJobs.com — Hong Kong
items.note: Aggregator; its search isn't reliable enough to read automatically.

items.name: NRF Fellowship
items.note: Independent research funding for early-career scientists that comes with a faculty or institute post. One call a year.

groups.title: Asia — China
groups.note: Science Careers and the Chronicle (read daily) carry many ads from Chinese universities. Joint-venture universities use English and a North American–style tenure track.

groups.title: Asia — India
groups.note: IITs, IISc and IISERs recruit through their own portals, often accepting applications year-round.

items.name: Ramanujan Fellowship (ANRF)
items.note: For scientists abroad returning to India; brings salary and research funds to a host institution.

items.name: Ramalingaswami Re-entry Fellowship (DBT)
items.note: The same idea for biotechnology and life sciences, including microbiome research.

items.name: Society job boards and mailing lists
items.note: Microbiology and ecology societies and their mailing lists often post faculty ads that never reach the big boards.

items.name: Department and institute career pages
items.note: Many calls, especially in Europe, appear only on the hiring university's own site. If you find one, submit it here so others see it too.
